_about: Shared labeled fixture corpus for the public lead-capture behavioral eval (PR6). Each fixture is one visitor turn. expects_offer = should the persona make exactly one connect/email offer this turn. must_not_say = substrings the persona response must NOT contain (identity/source assertions, newsletter framing, illegal re-offers, info-gating). Generated by a 6-agent ruflo panel + synthesizer; used by backend/scripts/eval_lead_capture.py (behavioral) and test_lead_capture_prompt_contract.py (static).
